title: Rabbi Zerikan, Son of Rabbi Zerikan’s Father-in-Law
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned at the end of Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot, chapter 7: he mentioned the Chanukah insertion in the blessing of the land, and they praised him.[^1]

notes.text: The Guggenheimer digital text of Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 7:5 explicitly names Rabbi Zerikan son of Rabbi Zerikan’s father-in-law and says that he mentioned Chanukah in the blessing of the land and was praised. This supports the local titles and blessing reference; the literal relationship is translated without binding either person to an authority record.
